annotations.title: Key figures for one Portuguese municipality

description: Key figures for one of Portugal's 308 municipalities. IMI rate and its history (Autoridade Tributária), INE median sale price per m² (actual sales, not asking prices), purchasing power and population, INE licensed buildings and new dwellings by year, municipal building-works cases by year where we collect them, the construction-barometer row, new-build developments in our catalogue, and the where-to-live guide if there is one. Every figure has its source and date; a figure that is not published is null, not estimated.

language.description: Language of the site content in the answer (verdicts, definitions, labels) and of the page links: pt, en, ru, ua (or uk), de, fr, nl. Field names and the summary stay English. Default: en

municipality.description: Municipality name in any case, accents optional (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos; Lisbon and Oporto are accepted) or its four-digit code (1312). Close spellings are found; two matches return an `ambiguous` error with candidates
